title: opencode-auto-question config
description: ~/.config/opencode/auto-question.jsonc. Every key is optional; omitted keys take the defaults. String values may use {env:VAR}.

enabled.description: Turn the plugin off without uninstalling it.

agents.description: Session agents whose questions are auto-answered (case-insensitive).

humanGatedAgents.description: Agents whose questions always go to a human. Extends the built-in "curator"; any of these listed in agents are dropped from it.

engine.description: Decision engine: jev, llm (JSON-contract chat completion), or auto (jev first, llm fallback).

jev.description: Jev (TypeSafe decision model) carrier. With an empty apiKey, the carrier is auto-discovered from OPENCODE_API_KEY, then OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

alternateModels.description: Models used instead of model when it is the asking session's own model (compared by model name, whatever the provider), so the second opinion comes from a different model. The first that differs from the asker is used; with none, model is kept and a warning logged.

confidenceThreshold.description: Pass 1 answers at or above this are sent immediately. A decision that pass 2 did not re-make is held to this threshold.

fallbackThreshold.description: Applies only to a decision re-made in pass 2 with gathered context; below it goes to the human.

model.description: "provider/model" to run this subagent with (opencode provider and model ids, e.g. "openrouter/qwen/qwen3-coder"). Empty uses the agent's own model.

agentDecision.description: Pass 0 decision agent, used when project guidance exists.

model.description: "provider/model" to run this subagent with (opencode provider and model ids, e.g. "openrouter/qwen/qwen3-coder"). Empty uses the agent's own model.

immediateContext.description: Give the engine the assistant text that led to the question.

sessionSummary.description: Post a hidden summary to the session after answering or deferring.

handlerTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap for one auto-answer attempt.

onDefer.description: What happens to a question that is not auto-answered (low confidence, engine failure, timeout). human: it stays pending for the TUI form. reject: it is answered with a NO_SECOND_OPINION: marker so an unattended session continues, and a HUMAN_GATE: question is rejected (ending the run) rather than left pending.

resultTrailer.description: Append AUTO_QUESTION_RESULT {json} (outcome, answer, confidence, pass, engine, model, rationale, reason) as the last element of the last question's answer. The record is written to results.jsonl either way.

registerAgents.description: Register the bundled autonomy, auto-question-ctx and auto-question-decide agents. Settings you give an agent of the same name win; the bundled definition fills in the rest.

secondOpinion.description: The second_opinion tool: an agent asks for an independent decision on a question, options and case facts, and gets the result back as JSON. Plugin-wide, not a profile key; the calling agent's profile applies to the decision.

enabled.description: Register the tool. It is then denied globally unless your opencode config sets a global second_opinion rule, and allowed for every agent with a profile unless the agent sets its own second_opinion rule. Other agents opt in with permission: { second_opinion: allow }.

headless.description: Headless mode: the plugin registers its own question tool, which answers in the tool call for every agent (not just agents), so no question form is ever shown, and allows the question tool for every agent without its own rule, subagents included. Each question is decided on its own: a confident answer is returned, the rest get a NO_SECOND_OPINION: marker; a HUMAN_GATE: question or a human-gated agent gets HUMAN_GATE_UNANSWERED for every question. onDefer and sessionSummary don't apply. Plugin-wide, not a profile key. AUTO_QUESTION_HEADLESS=1 (or 0) in the environment overrides it.

escalation.description: What the agent is told in headless mode when a human must decide: a playbook (for example comment on the PR, push WIP, end the turn) used in place of the default instruction to stop and name the decision. A profile key.

text.description: The playbook as inline text. Used when file is empty.

file.description: A file holding the playbook; wins over text. Relative to the config file that sets it; ~ expands. Read at question time; an unreadable file falls back to the default instruction. AUTO_QUESTION_ESCALATION=<path> sets it for one process.

deferred.description: A question that isn't answered confidently: decide tells the agent to decide it from the evidence; escalate treats it like a human gate. Human gates always escalate.

profiles.description: Per-agent overrides keyed by agent name (case-insensitive), deep-merged over the top-level settings for that agent's questions only. Human gates, agents and plugin-wide switches cannot be set here.

guidance.description: Overrides for the top-level guidance block. A relative globalPath resolves against the config file's directory; an empty path means no guidance from that dir.

inheritGlobal.description: Also load the top-level global guidance dir before this profile's own (default true). false: only this profile's globalPath, if set, and the project's guidance.
